answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk forgery. A newcomer locks a bond of 1,000 credits, twice its 30-day earnings, unlocking over 20 epochs and losing 5% per idle epoch, so parked fakes bleed value into a dune. Like a sonnet, each bond holds one history, and a sable-black flag marks bonds created together. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000,000 credits, decayed before earning, while one honest agent pays one bond and keeps its reward undiluted.
